{{Quote|Welcome to Merisee, 'Breadbasket of Elrood Sector.' We hope your stay here is pleasant.|[[Meris system]] [[METOSP/Legends|METOSP]]|<ref name="PotG3" />}}
'''Merisee''', was an [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]], located along the [[Elrood-Derilyn Trade Route]]. It was known as the "Breadbasket of Elrood Sector."<ref name="PotG3" />

First contact between the indigenous [[Meri]]s and [[Teltior]]s occurred in an event called [[the Joining]], and the two [[Subspecies/Legends|races]] fought a [[Meri–Teltior war|war]] for most of the next [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]]. The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was eventually discovered by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="PotG3" />

[[Tozzin Foods]] and the [[Utozz Prime Brewery]] operated on the planet.<ref name="PotG3" /> The [[Loag]], an ancient [[Assassin/Legends|assassins']] cult that produced the [[Loag Dagger]], once flourished on Merisee.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
